answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 21113 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: My sisters daughter name is SABAAT,maening Sachai(truthness),Majbooti . Is this write name? if no, suggest any good one. Question: AsSalamalaikum My sisters daughter name is SABAAT,maening Sachai(truthness),Majbooti . Is this write name? if no, suggest any good one. JazakAllah Answer ID: 21113 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 459/459/M=1431) Sabaat ( ثبات ) name does not sound much good for a girl, though it carries good meaning. However, it is better to choose a name from among the names of the wives of the holy Prophet Muhammad ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) and Sahabiyat i.e. Ayesha, Hafsah, Safiyyah, Maimunah etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
